item.title: ALBUM REVIEW: With 'Let Us Clap' Lamisi Celebrates the Traditional and the Au Courant
item.description: Ghanaian activist, poet, and musician Lamisi (assisted by producer Wanlov the Kubolor) merges pop, protest, and an attunement to the ephemeral nature of life. Built around catchy melodies, club-ready beats, and lush textures, Let Us Clap spotlights Lamisi’s affinity for the au courant and reverence for the traditional.
